events.title: Early Access - Coming October 30, 2026
events.summary: Early Access Launching October 30, 2026Happy to announce that Mercenary Brotherhood is launching October 30, 2026. There will be a larger announcement the date of launch, but basically it is launching main feature complete with Early Access. First, almost all the equipment images are now hand drawn art (about 20 new images). events.title: Demo Patch - Sept 9 - Improved Tutorial, Destructible Terrain and More
events.summary: This demo patch is a bigger one as it now makes terrain destructible. Tired of having a wall block you? Smash it down and go through the rubble. Burn down trees to remove the cover. This opens up more strategic options. Note to attack terrain you need to hold down the control key. Also the tutorial has been completely redone based on player feedback. events.summary: Emergent StoriesI am going to take a different approach to this dev diary and not show new screens or features but talk about something more subtle that I love about games, emergent stories. events.title: Demo Hotfix - July 31 - Vendetta fix + to hit buff
events.summary: This hotfix is focused on addressing a rare issue that only impacts a couple players right now. The Inquisition faction, a mid to late game faction, was ambushing them and becoming vendettas way too early in the game. This made for unwinnable fights.Tip: - If you like the game and where it is going, tell your friends. Better yet, post on Reddit or other forums. events.title: Demo Hotfix - July 30 - More interesting world to explore
events.summary: This hotfix heavily reworks the world generation to make it more interesting to explore. Before it was all procedural. It was plains with sporadic groups of hills or trees or mountains. However besides finding the occasional monster lair or enemy base, there wasn't incentive to explore.This changes the world into different biome terrains. events.title: Demo Hotfix - July 26 - Building revamp, siege revamp and more tweaks
events.summary: This hotfix heavily reworks two key areas; multi-story buildings and sieges. Unlike many medieval/fantasy turn based tactics games, I really wanted to have buildings in this game that you can enter. And not just normal buildings but multi-story ones. Some of my favorite games, like XCom, have this already so I wanted to add it. And I thought it would be really epic to have a large, sprawling, multi-story castle to attack. events.summary: This hotfix fixes some pathfinding issues. For some reason, mercs were thinking the straightest path to a tile three steps forward was to zig zag there. That is fixed, along with similar issues with pushing mechanics. Yet with an emphasis on abilities, especially magic, with Mercenary Brotherhood I started adding it and it made a great difference. events.summary: This hotfix addresses one key challenge seen with the demo, which is easing in new players. This will evolve over time. Another big changes is the battle flow through tweaks in attack and movements economy.
